title: HtmlStyle
responsibility: Renders the native style element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlStyle.attributes
inputs.description: Native style attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlStyle.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native style element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlStyle
outputs.description: The actual native style element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
